messages:
sam: Heads-up: EU-prod fleet hitting sustained 96% GPU utilization, streaming requests queuing behind sync batches. Latency SLOs for chat customers at risk. Anyone digging in?
infra-bot: Alert: gpu_utilization_eu > 90% for 12m. top_queues: sync-batch=65%, streaming=35%. rolling restart events none.
joan: Looking now. Seen heavy batch retraining jobs + a traffic spike from dedicated-tenant-42.
michael: Quick check of admission logs — streaming admission rate dropped ~4x after 1912342000. Query I ran:```sh
# recent admission counts by class
curl -s http://metrics/api/streams?from=1912340000 | jq '.classes|{streaming, sync_batch}'
# output
{"streaming": 120, "sync_batch": 980}
```
sam: Confirmed. Our headroom calc is favoring token throughput: `admission_strategy: maximize_tokens`. That pushes large sync batches to fill GPUs and backpressure small streaming slots.
alyssa: Proposal: temporary mitigation — reduce sync_batch concurrency on EU pools by 20% and create a streaming priority class with min_tokens_reserved=10%. Can flip safely? :thinking_face:
joan: I can throttle dedicated-tenant-42 to lower priority via quota mask. Oncall OK to proceed with a quick toggle?
oncall: Do it. Watch p50 chat latency. If p50 > 250ms revert. :eyes:
infra-bot: Plan queued: update admission policy -> set priority_class.streaming=high, reserve_tokens_pct=10. Rolling to eu-* pools with canary on eu-pool-b. Change id: ap-191234.
michael: Also recommend lowering max_seq for long-running syncs as emergency measure: `sync_max_seq: 2048 -> 1024` to trim tail memory pressure.
sam: Aware of cost tradeoff — more batches means higher GPU cycles, but SLOs first.
joan: Change applied to canary. Early telemetry: streaming p50 down 420ms -> 180ms within 5m. Batch raw throughput dip ~6%.
alyssa: Good win. I'll add alerting: streaming_queue_length > 20 per-pool and admission_fairness_ratio < 0.6. Opening PR for admission config + runbook with rollback steps.
sam: Follow-up: product/infra sync to evaluate model-scheduler change: "priority-aware packing" so tiny streaming requests get packed into leftover slots without destroying batch economics.
infra-bot: Note: created incident task IT-6912 to track follow-ups and cost modeling.
joan: TL;DR — temporary priority + reserved tokens fixed SLO, need longer-term scheduler change + finer-grained quotas for dedicated tenants.
sam: Thanks all. Keep an eye on EU for another 30m then we can revert the emergency limits if stable. :thumbsup:
